meta.title: Roam Phone
meta.notes: One paid generation, extended once, with our graphics laid over it. roam-2a-t2 (8 s, from ad-roam-2a; t1 was rejected) was continued by the provider with ad-roam-2b (8 s), which returns the source clip and its new tail as one 16 s file, roam-2-full-t1; its first 192 frames match roam-2a-t2 and the lawn starts on frame 192 (8.0 s). compose.mjs then laid our ROAM PHONE (12.4 s, faded in over 0.25 s, so it starts a frame before the packshot) and Talk anywhere. Almost. (14.0 s, faded in over 0.25 s) over it, each to 16.1 s (past the end, so the cut ends them), and copied the sound, giving roam-2-final, byte-identical to review/clips/ad-roam-phone-take2.mp4. The segments are the take's own shots, in step, cut where the picture cuts (frame/24). All the sound is the take's own: the announcer and the dad on the phone, whose words are the transcriber's (the storyboard gives him none).

segments.label: The kitchen: the wall phone's cord knocks the fruit over
He hangs the wall phone up for good
Close: the cordless handset off its base, the antenna up, a grin
Still on the phone, he strolls across the lawns to the neighbour's barbecue
Packshot: the handset in its base on sky blue

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Tired of being tied to the wall?

lines.speaker: Announcer

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: No, I agree. That's why we need to do it.
